column1: #zone label(starter_zones) start(1; 1) message(Set up your core zones; a meeting area for morale; a pasture for grazers; a dump for refuse.)
tags: zone, meeting area, pasture, starter

description: Three core early-fort zones laid out side by side: a meeting area where idlers gather and boost morale; a pen or pasture for grazing animals; and a garbage dump for refuse. Place them near the fort entrance so dwarves and animals reach them quickly.
